id.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

object.description: The object type, which is always `thread.message`.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was created.

thread_id.description: The [thread](/docs/api-reference/threads) ID that this message belongs to.

status.description: The status of the message, which can be either `in_progress`, `incomplete`, or `completed`.

anyOf.description: On an incomplete message, details about why the message is incomplete.

reason.description: The reason the message is incomplete.

anyOf.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was completed.
The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was marked as incomplete.

role.description: The entity that produced the message. One of `user` or `assistant`.

content.description: The content of the message in array of text and/or images.

anyOf.description: If applicable, the ID of the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) that authored this message.
The ID of the [run](/docs/api-reference/runs) associated with the creation of this message. Value is `null` when messages are created manually using the create message or create thread endpoints.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to attach to the message.

tools.description: The tools to add this file to.

anyOf.description: A list of files attached to the message, and the tools they were added to.

x-oaiMeta.name: The message object
